ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a brain schematic diagram of the median sagittal plane of the head, with multiple regions labeled with letters. The pointer line of label F points to a small gland-like structure below the center of the brain, near the base of the brain, located behind the face and near the lower part of the brain. Reasoning: The question asks “which region contains the gland that affects growth, metabolism, and maturation.” The pituitary gland located at the base of the brain secretes hormones, regulates growth, and affects metabolism and sexual maturation. The label corresponding to this gland position in the diagram is F.
